title: Story: Display Reflections foil tables and invite missing-scan contributions
body:
## User story
As a collector and potential contributor, I want Light Side and Dark Side tables of the actual foil printings on every Reflections set page, below its exclusive cards, so I can inspect each foil and immediately see where a correct scan is needed.

## Authorization
Bill,14 November2026: “I think below the exclusive cards available to a reflections set (if any), we should have a Light Side and Dark Side Table for the actual Foiled cards. I think this is actually really important. If there is a blank, that is our clue that we need to try to get people's help to fill in a scan. We might want some symbol or picture to let the world know we have missing data and to please help us with a scan. Make a story for these and then when done, begin working”. This authorizes implementation now; no policy question remains. It supersedes the older set-import instruction to postpone regular foil tables.

## Requirements
- R1 Add separate Light Side and Dark Side regular-foil tables to Reflections, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy, and Reflections III. Put them below any exclusive-card tables; preserve existing premium/exclusive, Japanese, box-topper and collecting content.
- R2 Reconcile exactly314 regular foil entries (114/100/100) against completed story381. Each row links the exact publication article and uses its actual foil image and printing-specific fields, including language/AI distinctions. No non-foil image substitutions or invented fields.
- R3 Keep missing image/data cells honest. Supply an accessible reusable camera/scan-request marker with a clear invitation and working upload/source-discussion links. Explain it briefly on the set lists; do not use the marker as a fabricated card image or claim a missing scan has been recovered. Existing photographs remain visible and can invite cleaner scans without being mislabeled missing.
- R4 Preserve current article heads, existing non-foil/exclusive rows and external citations. No mass card-content changes or image uploads are needed for this display story; preserve separate preservation ownership under412.
- R5 Preview and verify exact source/current supported reviews, public Cite/thumbnail/target counts, absence of wrong-printing images, and desktop/mobile output. Independently back up exact drafts and published revisions; merge source/evidence and report all changed URLs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 Dated audit records existing set sections, intended placement,314 exact publication/image mappings and genuine missing-image/data counts.
- [ ] AC2 All three set pages have complete Light/Dark foil tables below any exclusive cards, with114/100/100 distinct correct targets and printing-specific thumbnails/fields; exclusive and unrelated content is conserved.
- [ ] AC3 Scan-request UI is text-labeled and usable without interpreting color/icon alone, links to contribution/source discussion, preserves blanks and passes an explicit empty/missing-image preview fixture. Existing available images are not falsely flagged absent.
- [ ] AC4 Draft/live lint, supported own-bot review, source conservation, current public rendering/Cite, image/row/target checks and representative desktop/mobile checks pass. Exact backup receipts and existing preservation jobs are retained honestly.
- [ ] AC5 Source/live backups are merged, evidence and full changed URLs are shared, per-AC PASS report posted and story closed only after verified delivery.

## Plan and verification
Read current set/article/template heads and completed381 evidence. Build foil tables from exact Card parameters and fixed publication inventory; preserve existing exclusive rows, relocate only complete sections as needed. Implement a small reusable request marker and a terse contribution legend. Preview one set and marker fixtures, publish scoped guarded template/set/Talk changes, verify counts/images/links/desktop/mobile, merge backups and close with a PASS report. No peer review is required unless Bill asks. Evidence: section/image audit (AC1), exact row and conservation reports (AC2), marker fixtures (AC3), source/public/visual and backup receipts (AC4), merge and PASS report (AC5).

## Scope
Regular Reflections I–III foils and their set-page presentation only. No new card articles, non-foil premium rewrites, artificial foil rendering, deletion, GEMP change, server configuration or new preservation worker. Missing original evidence remains explicitly pending; external capture does not block sourced display work under the approved preservation workflow.
